manga_title: My Wife Is From a Thousand Years Ago 195
text:
Page 001
001-1. junitiusNyansjutiujtius RP CL/RD TS TL
001-2. Paragon Scans
001-3. discord.gg/pErHvcxdrx

Page 002
002-1. I'M RARELY SICK...
002-2. ARE YOU OKAY? DO YOU NEED TO GO TO THE HOSPITAL?
002-3. I'M FINE,THIS IS NOTHING.I JUST HAVE A STLFFY NOSE...
002-4. THERE'S NOTHING TO WORRY ABOUT, IT'S NOT ENOUGH TO KILL ME.
002-5. OKAY THEN...
002-6. DON'T OVER- THINK IT, I'LL BE FINE AFTER A NIGHT'S REST.

Page 003
003-1. LET'S SLEEP IN SEPARATE ROOMS TONIGHT.
003-2. I'M AFRAID OF SPREADING BADAIR TO YOU...IS THAT THE CORRECT TERM? IN ANY CASE,I'M AFRAIDOF PASSING THE VIRUS TO YOU, THAT'S WHAT I MEANT.
003-3. WEVE BEENSLEEPING IN THE SAME BEDFOR A FEW DAYS NOW, THERE'S NO NEED TO BE AFRAID THAT SHE WON'T LET ME SLEEP WITH HER AGAIN, EVEN WITH THS SHORTBREAK.
003-4. THE WARRIORESS.. SHOULD HAVE A STRONG IMMUNE SYSTEM, RIGHT?
003-5. SHE'SASTRONGPERSONFROM ANCIENTTIMES AFTER ALL
003-6. I'LL SLEEP IN THE STORAGE ROOM FOR THE NEXT COUPLE OF DAYS.
003-7. A PROPER REST IS REQUIRED FOR A QUICK RECOVERY.
003-8. ARE YOU REALLY OKAY?

Page 004
004-1. I'M FINE, DON'T WORRY.
004-2. IF I DON'T TREAT THS COLD SERIOUSLY, IT WILL GET WORSE, AND I'LL BE BATTLING OTHER SYMPTOMS LIKE A RUNNY NOSEAND MIGRAINES, IT'LL BE A TORTURE.
004-3. ALSO, THESWORDSWILL BEDELIVEREDTHEDAYAFTER TOMORROW, THERE'S NO WAY I CANFILM A PROMOTIONALVIDEO FORTHESWORDSWHILESNOT IS RUNNING DOWN MY NOSE.
004-4. WHAT'S UP?

Page 005
005-1. I JUST LOOKED IT UP TO SEE IF YOU WILL DIE FROM YOUR SYMPTOMS.
005-2. HE WAS FINEALL ALONG, HEWASFINEALLAIONG HOWDID HESUDDENLYDEVELOP HEART INFLAMMATION, BRAIN IN- FLAMMATION,ANDNOSETUMORS. AMI GOING TOGET WIDOWED BEFORE WE EVENMARRY?
005-3. IT'S BEST IF WE GO SEE A PHYSICIAN--
005-4. WAIT! HOLO ON!
005-5. AT THIS RATE THAT YOU'RE GRABBING ME I'LL REALLYDIE!
005-6. I'VE TOLDYOU BEFORE, THE INTERNET WILL ONLY EVER DIAG- NOSE YOUWITHTERMINAL ILLNESSES.DON'T TRUST WHAT YOU SEE ON THE INTERNET BLINDLY,

Page 006
006-1. TRUST ME, THIS IS JUST A MINOR COLD.
006-2. BUT...
006-3. HAA..
006-4. 10MINUTES LATER
006-5. ARE YOU SURE YOU WON'T JUST SUDDENLY DIE?

Page 007
007-1. I WON'T. IDEFINITELY WON'T!
007-2. IT'S SUCH A WARM DAY BUT YOU'RE STILL USING A BLANKET, ARE YOU REALLY OKAY?
007-3. I'MREALLY OKAY, IT'S BEST TO SWEAT IT OUT WHEN YOUHAVE A COLD.IF YOU DONT BELIEVE ME,JUST TAKE A LOOK AT THE THERMOMETER INSTEAD.
007-4. LOOK, 37.3 CELSIUS,I'M JUST HAVING A TINY FEVER.
007-5. IT'S STILL WITHIN THE ACCEPTABLE RANGE, YOU DON'T HAVE TO WORRY.
007-6. YOUR FEVER WON'T SUDDENLY SHOOT UP TO 40 CELSIUS IN THE MIDDLE OF THE NIGHT, RIGHT?
007-7. HOW WOULD THAT BE POSSIBLE, 40 CELSIUS IS ENOUGH TO FRY ENOUGH TO ERY MY BRAINS,
007-8. THE MOST IMPORTANT THING FORMENOWIS TO REST AND RECOVER.

Page 008
008-1. ANYWAY,YOU DON'T HAVE TO WORRY ABOUT ME TOOMLCH,GO REST TOO.
008-2. ...OKAY.
008-3. IVEONLY SHARED A BED WITH THE WAR- RIORESS FOR A FEW DAYS, ANDNOWIMBACKTO SLEEPINGALONEAGAIN.
008-4. THE PSYCH- OLOGICAL GAP...
008-5. THIS DAMN COLD!

Page 009
009-1. WHO'S THAT?
009-2. WHAT ARE YOu DOING?
009-3. I'MSEEING IF YOUR FEVER HAS WORSENED, SHOULD WE MEASURE YOUR TEMPERATURE AGAIN?
009-4. I'M REALLY FINE,
009-5. WHAT TIME IS IT?
009-6. IT'S PAST 3.

Page 010
010-1. I'M REALLY OKAY, YOU SHOULD GO TO BED.
010-2. BUT...
010-3. LET'S JUST SLEEP TOGETHER THEN, IT SAVES YOU THE TROLBLE OF OVERTHINKING.
010-4. IT REALLY... DOESN'T SEEM AS HOTASI IMAGINED.
010-5. .I REALLY WON'T GET TO REST IF YOU DON'T STOP RUBBING ME.

Page 011
011-1. AREN'T YOU GOING TO SAY THAT YOU'LL PASS YOUR SICKNESS TO ME NOW?
011-2. I'VE THOUGHT IT THROUGH,I SHOULD JUST PASS THE COLD TO YOU TO LET YOU EXPERIENCE IT. OTHERWISE, YOU'LL THINK THAT I'M ABOUT TO DIE EVERY TIME I CATCH ACOLD.
011-3. IT LOOKS LIKE IT'S REALLY NOTHING MUCH IF HE'S STILL ABLE TO SAY THINGS LIKE THAT.
011-4. Good night, Xu Qing.
